name: WildWorld
summary: 面向可交互生成式角色扮演世界模型的大规模动作条件游戏数据集，带显式角色状态、相机位姿和深度标注。
summaryEn: A large-scale action-conditioned game dataset for interactive generative world models, with explicit character state, camera pose, and depth annotations.
scale: 108M+ frames; first released part contains 574 hours
scaleZh: 超过 1.08 亿帧；首批已发布部分为 574 小时
access: Part 1 available on Hugging Face; later parts are planned
accessZh: 第一部分已在 Hugging Face 提供，后续部分计划发布
verdict: 具有动作、状态和视觉观测的超大规模交互世界建模数据
verdictEn: Large-scale interactive world-modeling data with actions, states, and visual observations
wmNote: 显式状态与固定动作接口适合研究动作条件预测和长期一致性。
wmNoteEn: Explicit states and action interfaces support action-conditioned prediction and long-horizon consistency research.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2603.23497] WildWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset for Dynamic World Modeling with Actions and Explicit State toward Generative ARPG
evidence.statement: Game rollouts expose explicit state with synchronized action labels across more than 108 million frames.
